PART A - Creating Vectors and List
Question #1
```{r}
# a. Create vector
age <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 43, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 41, 53, 40, 18, 44, 38, 41, 48, 27, 39, 19, 30, 61, 54, 58, 26, 18)

# b. How many data points?
length(age)


# c. Min and Max values
min(age) 
max(age)  

# d. Access 13rd to 18th AND 33th to 35th elements
age[c(13:18, 33:35)]


# e. All but 10th, 20th, 30th, and 40th elements
age[-c(10, 20, 30, 40)]

# f. Modify 4th, 14th, 24th, and 44th elements to 0
age[c(4, 14, 24, 44)] <- 0
age
```
Question#2
```{r}
# Load built-in dataset
data(rivers)

##A. Get the number of elements (length) in rivers, their sum (sum), mean (mean), median(median), variance(var), standard deviation(sd), minimum (min) and maximum (max).
# Store all results in one vector
rivers_stats <- c(
  length = length(rivers),
  sum = sum(rivers),
  mean = mean(rivers),
  median = median(rivers),
  variance = var(rivers),
  sd = sd(rivers),
  min = min(rivers),
  max = max(rivers)
)
##B. What is the result? The derived result must be in just one(1) vector name.
# Display result
rivers_stats
```
Question#3
```{r}
# Create vectors
celeb_name <- c("Dwayne Johnson", "Taylor Swift", "J.K. Rowling", "Cristiano Ronaldo", "Lionel Messi")
power_ranking <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
annual_pay <- c(87.5, 80.0, 95.0, 105.0, 110.0)

# Modify J.K. Rowling's ranking and pay
idx <- which(celeb_name == "J.K. Rowling")
power_ranking[idx] <- 15
annual_pay[idx] <- 90

# Check updated values
celeb_name
power_ranking
annual_pay
```
Question#4
```{r}
# a. Create vector
vegetables <- c("Carrot", "Broccoli", "Spinach", "Cabbage", "Tomato",
                "Onion", "Eggplant", "Pechay", "Squash", "String Beans")
vegetables

# b. Add 2 vegetables at the end
vegetables <- append(vegetables, c("Potato", "Radish"))
vegetables

# c. Number of data points
length(vegetables)

# d. Add 4 vegetables after index 5
vegetables <- append(vegetables, c("Bell Pepper", "Garlic", "Ginger", "Okra"), after = 5)
vegetables

# e. Final count
length(vegetables)
```
